facts.text_en: Sierra Gorda produced 165,313 tonnes of fine copper in 2025 and 154,559 tonnes in 2024; its first year with reported production is 2014 (Cochilco, Chilean copper mine production by company).
facts.text_es: Sierra Gorda produjo 165.313 toneladas de cobre fino en 2025 y 154.559 toneladas en 2024; su primer ano con produccion reportada es 2014 (Cochilco, produccion chilena de cobre de mina por empresa).
